summary: Post-refactor regression on server.py -> routers/{auth,content,planner,reliability}.py against LIVE OpenAI (AI_PROVIDER=openai, ai_live=true). 17/17 new regression tests PASS in 37s, covering every group requested. No 500s and no NameError entries in backend.err.log since 20:00 UTC (only the previously-fixed defaultdict entries at 19:57/19:59 remain historical). Verified: (1) auth: dev-login issues tokens, /me returns correct email, unauth /api/tasks=401, /auth/refresh rotates and old refresh becomes 401, /auth/logout revokes; (2) A-vs-B isolation: A's tasks/events/courses/export not visible to B, B PATCH & DELETE of A's task both return 404 and A's task survives; (3) tasks/events CRUD 200; task->status=done cancels its pending reminders (status=cancelled); (4) LIVE AI: /capture returns real committed/review, /import returns doc_type + review items, /notes/generate returns study_notes dict with real content, /search returns {answer, citations, mode}; (5) /api/briefing returns 200 with stats/risks/recommendation (the regression is FIXED), plus /evening-review, /weekly-review, /timeline (+?kind=task), /courses, /courses/{name}, /review all 200; (6) reliability: /capture writes commitments (state scheduled/detected) and ledger transitions; reminder lifecycle: delivered sets external_id, snoozed reschedules to snooze_until (status becomes 'scheduled' per rel.set_reminder_status), failed retries increment retry_count to 3 and final state=failed; /reminders/sync returns reminders+routines+quiet_hours+server_time; /reminders/health returns counts; (7) calendar: POST /events -> visible in /calendar/pending; /calendar/sync {mappings} returns synced:1 and pending no longer includes it; /calendar/unlink/{id} reappears; (8) chunked upload: init->chunk(0)->/complete=409 (missing 1/2), chunk(1)->/complete=200 with {transcript_id,text,bytes}, repeat /complete=200 same transcript_id (idempotent); (9) Idempotency-Key: two /capture with same key -> byte-identical bodies, ai-usage unchanged; (10) daily cap: PUT prefs daily_ai_limit=1 -> first capture 200, second capture 429 with 'limit' in message, restore to 150 and /ai-usage returns used/limit/remaining; (11) PUT/GET /prefs persists morning_time; /export includes commitments, ledger, reminders, tasks, events; DELETE /me returns 200 and prior refresh_token becomes 401. All endpoints reachable — no missing routes. Health: {ai_provider: openai, ai_configured: true, ai_live: true, db: true}.
